title: Kashmir: Srinagar Gulmarg Pahalgam (5N/6D)
reportingPoint: Delhi, at 8 PM on the departure night (sleeper AC bus to Jammu). You can also board in Jammu or Srinagar at a lower price. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

pricing.name: Christmas & New Year: Delhi to Delhi
Christmas & New Year: from Jammu / Srinagar

overview:
Heaven on Earth, Delhi to Delhi: this **5 Nights / 6 Days** group trip covers Gulmarg's meadows and gondola, Sonmarg and Thajiwas Glacier, Aru, Betaab and Chandanwari in Pahalgam, the Mughal gardens of Srinagar and a night on a Dal Lake houseboat.

You leave Delhi at 8 PM by sleeper AC bus to Jammu and transfer to Srinagar on Day 1. Day 2 is Gulmarg, Day 3 Sonmarg, Day 4 Pahalgam with Aru, Betaab and Chandanwari included, and Day 5 the Srinagar gardens and a houseboat night with a 1-hour shikara ride. Day 6 is the drive back to Jammu and the bus to Delhi. Five nights in hotels and a houseboat, 5 breakfasts and 5 dinners and a tour leader are included. You can also board in Jammu or Srinagar. Prices start at ₹18,000 per person (triple sharing, from Jammu or Srinagar) and ₹20,000 Delhi to Delhi, plus 5% GST; Christmas and New Year batches cost more.
highlights: Gulmarg, the Meadow of Flowers, with the world's highest 18-hole golf course
Optional gondola to Khilanmarg for Nanga Parbat views on clear days (own cost)
Sonmarg and Thajiwas Glacier, where snow stays all year
Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari in Pahalgam, included
Mughal gardens: Chashma Shahi, Nishat and Shalimar, plus Shankaracharya Temple and Hazratbal
A night on a Dal Lake houseboat with a 1-hour shikara ride

itinerary.title: Delhi to Jammu | Overnight journey
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point at 8 PM, meet your team captain and the group, and depart by sleeper AC bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Jammu to Srinagar
itinerary.content:
Arrive in Jammu and transfer to Srinagar, taking in the drive into the valley.
Check in to your hotel in Srinagar.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg and back
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head to Gulmarg, the Meadow of Flowers, home to a famous ski resort and the world's highest 18-hole golf course.
Optional gondola to Khilanmarg (own cost) for Nanga Parbat views on clear days.
Back to Srinagar for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Sonmarg and back
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Sonmarg, the Meadow of Gold, at the head of the Sindh valley, with pine-forested mountains up to 5,300 m.
Take a pony ride (own cost) to Thajiwas Glacier, where snow remains all year.
Back to Srinagar for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam via Pampore, Avantipura and Bijbehara, the breadbasket of Kashmir.
Visit Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari (included).
Dinner and overnight stay at a hotel in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Srinagar sightseeing and houseboat
itinerary.content:
Check out and tour Srinagar: Chashma Shahi, Nishat Garden, Shalimar Garden, Shankaracharya Temple and Hazratbal.
Check in to your houseboat and enjoy a shikara ride.
Dinner and overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Jammu and back to Delhi
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive back to Jammu and board the bus to Delhi.
Reach Delhi the next day (Day 7).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: From Delhi at 8 PM on the departure night, by sleeper AC bus to Jammu. You can also join in Jammu or Srinagar. Leave on the first date of your batch and you are back in Delhi on the last (7 days later).

faqs.q: How much does the Kashmir trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates, Delhi to Delhi: ₹20,000 per person on triple sharing and ₹22,000 on double; from Jammu or Srinagar: ₹18,000 and ₹20,000. On Christmas and New Year batches, Delhi to Delhi: ₹23,000 and ₹25,000; from Jammu or Srinagar: ₹20,000 and ₹22,000. 5% GST is extra.

Sleeper AC bus Delhi to Jammu and back, sightseeing by tempo traveller or cab, 5 nights in hotels and a houseboat, 5 breakfasts and 5 dinners, Aru, Betaab and Chandanwari, a 1-hour shikara ride and a tour leader.
5% GST, Srinagar airport transfers, lunches, the Gulmarg gondola, the Sonmarg zero point cab, pony rides and other activities, entry fees, tips and personal expenses.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay ₹6,000 per person to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding.
The ₹6,000 advance isn't refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use.
